description: Overwrite properties of an existing node; use for simple attribute changes like setting a status, priority, or due date. Only the provided fields will be changed. For content or structural changes, consider `naumu_delegate` instead - it understands the full graph context and can propagate updates to related nodes. Attribute keys AND values must match the schema for the node type; use naumu_get_schema to check valid attribute names, types, and values before updating. Date attributes accept either null (to clear), an ISO date string "YYYY-MM-DD" (single day), or { start: "YYYY-MM-DD", end?: "YYYY-MM-DD" } (inclusive range). Example: { "due_date": { "start": "2026-05-21", "end": "2026-05-23" } } or { "due_date": "2026-05-21" } or { "due_date": null }. Select attributes accept the value label as a string. Person attributes accept the name, email or user id of a person this space knows (a member, a former member or an external person) as a string (null clears); a person attribute with `multiple: true` in the schema takes an array of them. The server resolves them against the people this space knows and rejects an unknown name with the list of people. Returns the updated node with its `url`; when you mention it, write [its label](url).

attributes.description: Schema-defined attributes to set. Examples: {"Status": "In Progress"}, {"due_date": {"start": "2026-05-21", "end": "2026-05-23"}}, {"due_date": "2026-05-21"}, {"due_date": null}.

claim.description: The words in the source that name this deliverable, copied verbatim, under 300 characters.

relationship.description: How the work in the source relates to the node this call changes: same, part_of, contributes_to, related, overlapping or uncertain. Required on a node you did not create and do not own; without it the server may answer 409 with what it needs.

name: naumu_update_node
title: Update Node
